posts.title: ⚡ OpenUtau Lunai 0.2.1.0 is out! @everyone
posts.content: ⚡ OpenUtau Lunai 0.2.1.0 is out! @everyone What's new for DiffSinger: • Project Expressions panel: set DiffSinger expression defaults per track • Singer styles: save and apply expression presets in one click • SBP Update and Fixes (PR by Cadlaxa) • Refined Phonemizer timing fixes (PR by overdramatic) Themes & look: • Theme Catalog: syncs community themes from GitHub (publishing your own themes to share with others is planned for a later update) • Color tint and temperature • Import (convert) classic OpenUtau themes to OpenUtau Lunai format • Note opacity and border thickness General changes and fixes: • Separate OpenUtau-Lunai data folder (shared singers): fixes many conflicts with other OpenUtau forks • Report issues via Discord / email • Updated translations from Crowdin (+ Arabic, Czech, Ukrainian added) • Merged 4 fix PRs from maiko3tattun: ALT alias revert, Ctrl note move, envelopes, and safer legacy-plugin DLL loading • Phonemizer menu filtered by engine • Phoneme panel auto-switches based on singer type • The left piano roll panel is now scrollable when it doesn’t fit on screen • Fixed some bugs and more... Simply open your OpenUtau Lunai to receive the update or https://lunaiproject.github.io/editor Found a bug? Let us know in <#1521944038952140942>

posts.title: OpenUtau Lunai 0.2.0.1 is out
posts.content: OpenUtau Lunai 0.2.0.1 is out Small update, important bug fixes • About OpenUtau: a tribute to everyone who contributed to the original OpenUtau on GitHub. Our way of saying thank you to the community that built this editor. Help → About OpenUtau • Fixed display of the search bar (Ctrl+F) and lyric editor popup • Modernized dialog controls and DiffSinger toolbar presets • Fixed several light theme issues (still not ready for convenient use) • Playback no longer resumes stale audio after edits during pause (experimental; disable in Preferences → Playback → Re-render after edits on play if needed) • Expression list updates on singer change, theme/track color refresh, render progress bar, missing translations restored, and more Plus the latest upstream OpenUtau fixes merged in Simply open your OpenUtau Lunai to receive the update or https://lunaiproject.github.io/editor Found a bug? Let us know in <#1521944038952140942>

posts.title: ⚡ OpenUtau Lunai 0.1.3.3 update has been released!
posts.content: ⚡ OpenUtau Lunai 0.1.3.3 update has been released! This is a test build. You may encounter bugs and crashes when using it Change log: - Singer Hub: a place where you can update or install DiffSinger voicebanks form trusted sources (currently Lunai, UFR and Brapa). In the future, we plan to make it possible to add your own singers here. It appears on the screen when you launch it, or you can open it in Tools -> Singer Hub... (pic. 1-3) - Solid playback line: this feature has been improved and is now in Preferences -> Playback (pic. 4) - TikTok recording mode: a test function that contains a preset for recording TikTok. It automatically detaches the piano roll in a separate window with a size of 9x16, change "Auto-Scroll" to "Stationary Cursor" with margin "0.5" and turn on "Solid playback line". To turn it on, go to View -> Piano Roll -> TikTok recording mode. To disable it and return your settings, disable it in the same place (pic. 5) - Improved smoothness of screen movement when "Stationary Cursor" is enabled. - .NET 8 was updated to .NET 10 (#1966) Hope all these innovations will make your experience in the program more convenient 💖 You can simply open your OpenUtau Lunai to receive the update notification, or install it here: https://github.com/keirokeer/OpenUtau-DiffSinger-Lunai/releases/tag/0.1.3.3

posts.title: <a:Vi_notify:977103248202809435>  **OpenUtau Lunai 0.1.3.0 update has been released!**
posts.content:
<a:Vi_notify:977103248202809435>  **OpenUtau Lunai 0.1.3.0 update has been released!**

*This is a test build. You may encounter bugs and crashes when using it*

The build has been updated to the latest test features in original StAkira's OpenUTAU, and some unreleased pull requests have been added. The most interesting:

- **Piano roll** is now **attachable** to main window
- **Custom themes** *(not sure if they will work properly)*
- **Track expressions**
- DiffSinger **Refined Phonemizer**
- DiffSinger **Portuguese BRAPA Phonemizer**
- **Liaison support** to **French Millefeuille Phonemizer**
- Many **bugs** have been **fixed** (but others appeared)

You can simply open your OpenUtau Lunai to receive the update notification, or install it here:
https://github.com/keirokeer/OpenUtau-DiffSinger-Lunai/releases/tag/0.1.3.0
